Sorry we missed you for the scheduled POC kickoff this morning. We want to get the hands-on working session back on the calendar and make sure your team can run the routing/load tests you mentioned.

- Fri, Jul 30 — 18:00 to 19:30 ET (preferred; our SEs available for live routing/debugging)

I've attached a short runbook and a load-test config that we'll use to set up the scenario. Can you confirm:
- Which timezone the team will join from
- Whether they can run a background load during the session

Thanks — look forward to reconnecting.
